The Big Valve Pack

By the community creator — see source

7Z · 64.16 MB listed archive size

The Big Valve Pack has a broad catalogued audio inventory, including judge and score sounds. Its size as a collection makes choosing an individual voice more useful than loading it and expecting one short movie-style scene.

Play one line or the whole Pack. Mic recordings stay on your device.

How to practice with this Pack

Start with a voice segment instead of an interface sound. Keep one reference selected while practicing so a change in the score reflects your take rather than a different target.

Compatibility and preparation

The supplied archive is 7z, not ZIP. Browser extraction and decoding must finish before play. If preparation fails, retain the source archive and use the local import path to inspect the error.

Load this Pack in DubRoundTest microphone first
What if loading fails?

Retry the source download or import your copy locally. Formats and browser decoders differ. You can return to the built-in game without waiting for this archive.

What can I save after recording?

DubRound can export accepted recordings and line data in a Pack ZIP. This does not create an MP4 movie. Keep your source and only publish material you have permission to share.
